Now the mock server. Key semantics mirroring the real Go backend:
- login: accept pw === raw || pw === md5(raw) (mirrors CompareHashedPassword dual compare), password length 6..100, username 3..50.
- refresh: single-use rotation; cookie `go_admin_refresh`, Path=/api/v1, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict.
- menus: Bearer check → 401 with body {code:401,message:"未授权"}.
- logout: invalidate session + delete cookie; flag to simulate network failure (socket destroy).

Controls: killAccessOnce, refreshFailInvalidate (delete session so refresh always 401), adoptNextRefreshCookie, logoutNetworkFail, holdRefresh/releaseRefresh(n), refreshDelayMs.
